title: Management Trainees and Managers Direct Recruitment Drive

important_dates.label: Last day for applying and payment of Examination fee

summary: Export-Import Bank of India has announced a direct recruitment drive to fill 120 vacancies for Management Trainees and Managers across various disciplines. Eligible candidates must apply online through the official website between November 27, 2026, and December 11, 2026. Selection involves a written examination followed by personal interviews.
eligibility_bullets: Minimum 60% aggregate marks in Graduation and Post Graduation or professional qualifications as applicable to the specific post.
Required qualifications include MBA, PGDBA, PGDBM, MMS, CA, CS, LLB, B.E./B.Tech, or MCA depending on the specific post.
Managers require a minimum of 4 years of relevant post-qualification experience.

vacancy_breakdown.notes: UR: 40, SC: 07, ST: 09, OBC (NCL): 25, EWS: 9, PwBD: 03
UR: 15, SC: 03, ST: 02, OBC (NCL): 07, EWS: 03, PwBD: 01

how_to_apply_steps: Read the detailed advertisement carefully and ensure eligibility before applying.
Visit the official careers website of Exim Bank.
Complete the online registration and application form.
Pay the examination fee through the online mode before the deadline.
